usedFor: Gomomento runs caches, and “Set a Value in a Cache” and “Create Topic” are the steps other events call.

bestTemplate.name: “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo, then “Set a Value in a Cache” in Gomomento
bestTemplate.why: An incoming message can store a value, so it is ready for the next step.

watchOut: “Delete Value From Cache” removes a stored value, so check the key before it runs.
